answer: Only a random sample of each identity's work is re-executed, but the sampling rate rises for clustered haven accounts, and a single failed check escalates the whole cluster to full whisper review. Findings land in the quill record and slash the cluster's shared bond. Because escalation is public and cheap to trigger, a farm cannot average bad work across many seats the way it can under independent random checks. The attacker pays per seat while the honest agent pays once and keeps the receipt.
